title: Microsoft Store for Business applications are still present

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'application uses', 'applications use')} the retired Store for Business

messages.businessImpact: The service behind these packages has been retired, so they will not install on new devices and will not update on existing ones.
remediation: Replace each with the Microsoft Store app type and reassign, then delete the old packages.
